thread:
elaine: Quick proposal  Lightweight EU-focused microcalc on pricing page. Aim: reduce "what will it cost" support tickets and push more mid-market signups.

mike: good idea. what's the success metric? increase trial starts or leads to SDR?

elaine: primary: +12% CTA -> trial starts. secondary: +6% qualified lead submissions. tertiary: 15% drop in pricing-related CS tickets.

nina: must be GDPR-friendly. show localized currency (EUR/GBP) and only store estimates if user opts in. Also add a short privacy snippet under the widget.

sam: dev feasibility: can detect locale and show EUR/GBP/USD, that's trivial. build a small React widget and wire events. estimate: 2 dev days + 1 QA day for minimal scope.

kevin: routing plan: estimator -> inline contact form -> calculate estimated ARR. If ARR >= 40k, tag as enterprise-interest and route to enterprise SDR queue. Otherwise send to self-serve nurture journey. Make threshold configurable (we'll A/B test 25k vs 40k).

elaine: agreed on testing thresholds. also want to test two CTA labels: Variant A "Estimate your monthly spend" vs Variant B "See plan pricing".

mike: copy draft (compact):
```
Estimate your monthly cost
Quickly estimate cost by tokens/month or pick a common use-case. Local currency and estimated ARR shown.
[Estimate your monthly cost]
```

tia: small UX note  show a tooltip on "tokens/month" with an example use-case. needed for non-technical buyers.

nina: localization: German/French drafts incoming. legal: include "Estimates are indicative" line. Will send legal-approved snippet.

sam: analytics events proposed: pricing_microcalc_open, pricing_microcalc_submit, pricing_microcalc_threshold_{hit|not_hit}, pricing_microcalc_lead_submitted. confirm namespace.

kevin: CRM fields: est_monthly_cost, est_ARR, use_case, locale, source_campaign. Add utm_campaign=pricing_microcalc_q2eu. I'll map to salesforce fields.

mike: will prepare the experiment spreadsheet (segments by traffic source: organic, paid, webinar follow-ups). Also will include a small funnel: widget impressions -> open -> submit -> lead complete -> trial start.

marketing-bot: Note: Webinar "Performance & Cost: Serving LLMs at Scale" on 2026-05-18. If we launch before that date, add a line to the webinar follow-up: "Try our pricing estimator".

elaine: timeline: finalize copy & legal by EOD Thu, eng ticket today, localization by Fri, QA next Tue, soft-launch to EU 50% traffic Wed. Run 14-day test.

sam: I'll open the PR and tag @mike for UI review. I'll also attach the analytics spec.

kevin: Sales ops will provide routing config and sample payload by EOD tomorrow.

mike: I'll post the two copy variants and update the experiment sheet here when ready.

elaine: thanks all. final checklist: copy approved, legal phrase, events wired, CRM mapping, translations. ping this thread when each step is done. :rocket:
